title: 4-Hour Private Hidden Hot Springs Tour near Death Valley
includes: Hotel pick-up and drop off (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Total duration includes the driving from start to end.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Escape the neon lights of Las Vegas and discover a hidden desert oasis just outside Death Valley National Park. This small-group tour takes you to a remote natural hot spring surrounded by the rugged beauty of the Mojave Desert. Soak under the stars in mineral-rich waters known for their relaxing and therapeutic benefits. Along the way, enjoy scenic views, desert wildlife, and stories about the region’s unique history from your local guide. Perfect for adventure-seekers and stargazers, this unforgettable night experience offers peace, solitude, and a deeper connection with nature.
